subject.title: fix(baseten): reject malformed model metadata numbers

question: Should Baseten live metadata continue accepting decimal-form numeric strings under the new grammar, or should OpenClaw require JSON numbers only and treat all strings as invalid provider data?
rationale: The upstream public docs confirm the endpoint and metadata categories but do not specify field representation, so the safe long-term compatibility contract cannot be inferred from source or documentation alone.

options.title: Confirm and keep decimal strings
options.body: Confirm an observed Baseten response or extension-owner intent that decimal/exponent strings are supported, then merge the narrow parser and fallback behavior.

options.title: Require JSON numbers only
options.body: Treat every string as malformed metadata and simplify the parser if the provider contract guarantees JSON numeric fields.

recommendation.title: Confirm and keep decimal strings
recommendation.body: Confirm an observed Baseten response or extension-owner intent that decimal/exponent strings are supported, then merge the narrow parser and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable feature-history owner could be established from the supplied read-only review context.
